in_marathi.name: Amrutha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrutha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the name Amrutha refers to the elixir of immortality. The gods were churning the ocean (Samudra Manthan) to obtain the nectar of immortality, Amrutha. The name Amrutha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amruta’, meaning nectar. The name is considered auspicious and is given to babies to bless them with a long and healthy life.

The name is considered auspicious and is given to babies to bless them with a long and healthy life.
